summary: This informational document lists requirements for taking down or bringing up a BGP session gracefully. Simply dropping a session can cause traffic loss for customers even when backup paths exist. The requirements describe what a solution must do so operators can do maintenance with minimal disruption.

eli5.summary: Closing a bridge for repairs without warning stops cars mid-trip. This document says what is needed so BGP routers can warn others first and traffic takes the detour smoothly.

questions: how to gracefully shut down a bgp session
